answer.rationale: Rollback is compliance-blocked, read-replica offload mis-targets a write-path p99, and a circuit breaker fits dependency failure (not indicated). The regional confinement makes failover tempting, but during settlement write peak a primary-region failover risks in-flight/customer writes, which the objective forbids; I am verifying b2 because it is the one record that could either clear or condemn that risk. Heavy writes at daily peak plus rising write latency point to primary-region saturation, so the single write-preserving lever is to add capacity now (headroom absorbed prior surge per b3) while leaving the security patch intact. Root cause is unconfirmed—the no-revert release may contribute—so uncertainty is preserved and capacity is reversible while we reassess next window.
